product_metadata.title: Farberware Classic Stainless Steel Frying Pan Set / Fry Pan Set / Stainless Steel Skillet Set - 8.25 Inch and 10 Inch, Silver
features: STAINLESS STEEL FRYING PANS: The full cap bases on the stainless steel frying pans feature a thick aluminum core surrounded by stainless steel for rapid, even heating
EASY HANDLING FRY PANS: Frying pans are oven safe to 350°F, the comfortable handles with iconic styling provide a confident grasp
DISHWASHER SAFE SKILLETS: These dishwasher-safe frying pans combine technology with the styling and quality that Farberware has delivered for decades
description: Frying pans are endlessly versatile, and this Farberware Classic Series Stainless Steel 8.25-Inch and 10-Inch Frying Pan Set features two of the most popular sizes. The full cap skillet bases featuring thick aluminum cores surrounded by stainless steel provide rapid, even heating. Heavy-duty stainless steel frying pan construction is polished to a mirror finish for a classic touch. The comfortable fry pan handles with iconic styling provide a confident grasp, and these frying pans are dishwasher safe and oven safe to 350°F. Every kitchen could use another frying pan and this skillet set makes a great addition to any Farberware cookware set. With two convenient frying pans, the Farberware Classic Series Stainless Steel 8.25-Inch and 10-Inch Frying Pan Set delivers years of skillet performance in the kitchen.
